_readme: Each PowerShell check is a SLOT fed by REAL output from a Windows PC (verbatim text from deliverables/collect-outputs.ps1, or a screen recording). status 'placeholder' renders a labeled stand-in with NO output text. To verify: put the exact lines in `lines`, set `source` (e.g. 'Windows 11, PowerShell 5.1, <date>'), set status 'verified', run `python3 build.py`. Never edit or invent output lines. Mask sensitive values only by masking them in the file and listing the mask in `masked`.

ps_bitlocker.note: Real Get-BitLockerVolume output. Usually needs an ADMIN PowerShell; if unavailable, put the real error text and the video shows an honest note.
